title: GoldNet: Benchmark Dataset and Code for Detecting Near-Identical Counterfeit Gold Images
description: GoldNet is a public benchmark dataset (2,127 smartphone photographs of authentic vs. counterfeit gold items) and PyTorch training/evaluation code accompanying the paper 'GoldFormer: A Texture-Aware Vision Transformer-Based Algorithm for Detecting Near-Identical Images' (Algorithms, 2026, 19(7), 530, DOI: 10.3390/a19070530). Trained model weights are hosted separately on Hugging Face (huggingface.co/zobeir/GoldNet).
